full_prompt_en: A square painted canal scene looks past two seated figures toward pale yellow embankments and a distant town. The foreground is a broad strip of muted brown pavement, with the pair seen from behind near the lower center. The figure on the left wears a black dress and a pale straw hat. Beside her, a larger figure in a black coat and high black hat makes a solid dark silhouette. A small dark object rests near the water edge to their right. The canal occupies the middle of the image as a blue green plane widening toward the foreground and narrowing at a central opening between the opposite banks. Dark green reflections of tall trees descend into the water at both sides, while the center remains comparatively clear and pale blue. Across the far bank, long yellow retaining walls form two strong horizontal blocks. A short bridge or roadway joins them at the central gap. Tiny people and a couple of small boats are reduced to simple dark marks along the banks and water. Beyond, rows of rounded dark trees frame a few ochre and yellow buildings. Near the upper center right, an orange industrial roof and two thin smoking chimneys rise above the town. The sky is a lightly textured gray blue with faint warm streaks. Sunlight falls broadly across the yellow walls and some buildings, but the foreground viewers and tree masses stay in deep shade. The contrast is carried by large flat areas more than fine modeling: black figures, yellow walls, blue water and dark green reflections meet at clear edges. Subtle brush grain gives the matte surfaces life without breaking their simplicity. The overall composition makes the seated pair a quiet dark anchor below a precise, sunlit canal geometry.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形运河绘画越过两位坐着的人物，望向浅黄色堤岸和远处小镇。前景是一片低饱和褐色铺地，两人背对观者坐在下方中央附近。左边人物穿黑裙、戴浅色草帽。旁边更大的人物穿黑外套、戴高黑帽，形成结实深色剪影。他们右侧靠水边有一个深色小物件。运河以蓝绿色平面占据画面中部，向前景变宽，在对岸中央缺口处收窄。高树的深绿倒影从两侧垂入水中，中央则较清透且呈浅蓝。对岸的长黄色挡墙形成两块强水平色域，一段短桥或道路在中央缺口连接它们。小人和几只小船被简化成岸边与水上的深色细痕。更远处，成排圆顶深色树框住少数赭色和黄色建筑。靠近上方中央偏右，橙色工业屋顶与两根冒烟细烟囱升在小镇上方。天空为略带肌理的灰蓝色，留着淡暖色条痕。阳光大面积落在黄墙和部分建筑上，前景观者与树团却保持深影。反差主要由大块平涂区域而非细腻塑形承担：黑人物、黄墙、蓝水和深绿倒影在清楚边缘相遇。细微笔触颗粒让哑光表面有生气，却不破坏简洁。整体构图让坐着的两人成为精确、受日照的运河几何下方安静深色支点。
style_prompt_en: The image has a matte painted finish organized by large, nearly flat color areas and firm simplified contours. Deep black and dark green masses anchor the foreground and edges, while broad butter yellow planes and cool blue green fields create the main visual contrast. Horizontal blocks and a central opening set a clear spatial rhythm; smaller dark marks punctuate the distant areas without competing with the large shapes. Light reads as even warmth on exposed planes and deep shade in opposing masses rather than gradual tonal modeling. Reflections repeat upper dark shapes as vertical downward bands, connecting separate regions of the composition. Slight brush grain softens the matte fills, but the boundaries remain decisive. The overall effect is quiet and graphic, with disciplined color placement and strong light-dark geometry carrying the scene.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有哑光绘画完成面，由大块近乎平涂色域和坚实简化轮廓组织。深黑与深绿团块稳住前景及边缘，宽阔奶油黄色平面与冷蓝绿色域构成主要视觉反差。水平块面和中央开口建立清楚空间节奏，远处小深色笔痕点缀其间，却不与大形体争夺注意力。光表现为暴露平面的均匀暖意和相对团块中的深影，而非渐变塑形。反射把上方暗形重复为向下竖带，连接构图的不同区域。轻微笔触颗粒柔化哑光填充，但边界仍果断。整体效果安静而图形化，有纪律的色彩位置与强烈明暗几何承载场景。
theme_en: Two dark-clothed figures seated beside a canal facing sunlit yellow embankments
theme_zh: 两位深衣人物坐在运河边，望向阳光照亮的黄色堤岸
name: Felix Vallotton
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
